# arin_roa (Resource)

Manage one hosted ROA, including IPv4, IPv6, AS0 and maximum prefix lengths. Changes use an atomic delete/add transaction and produce a new ARIN handle. Import existing ROAs using ORG-HANDLE/ROA-HANDLE. With auto_link enabled ARIN can adopt existing IRR routes. Updates preserve old routes after unlinking; destroy removes linked routes only when delete_linked_routes is true. Do not also manage linked routes with arin_irr_route. An uncertain write retains recovery state and never automatically repeats the transaction.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Replace these prefixes and ASN with resources authorized by your organization.
# Each prefix maps to the longest prefix length the origin may announce.
resource "arin_roa" "example" {
  org_handle = "EXAMPLE-1"
  name       = "Customer announcements"
  asn        = 19814
  prefixes = {
    "192.0.2.0/24"  = 24
    "2001:db8::/32" = 48
  }
  auto_link            = false
  delete_linked_routes = false
}

# Updates replace the ARIN handle in one atomic transaction.
# Use asn = 0 with auto_link = false for an AS0 authorization.
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `asn` (Number) Authorized origin AS number, including AS0. AS0 requires auto_link = false.
- `name` (String) ROA name.
- `org_handle` (String) Organization eligible for hosted RPKI. Changes require replacement.
- `prefixes` (Map of Number) Canonical IPv4/IPv6 CIDRs mapped to maximum prefix lengths. Use the CIDR length to authorize only the exact prefix.

### Optional

- `auto_link` (Boolean) Link all prefixes to IRR routes when writing the ROA. Defaults to false; must be false for AS0. On read, true only when all prefixes are linked; linked_prefixes reports individual links.
- `delete_linked_routes` (Boolean) Remove linked IRR routes when destroying this ROA. Defaults to false, which unlinks and preserves the routes. Updates always preserve old routes.

### Read-Only

- `auto_renewed` (Boolean) Server-reported automatic renewal status.
- `handle` (String) ARIN-generated ROA handle.
- `id` (String) ORG-HANDLE/ROA-HANDLE. Changes when the authorization is updated.
- `linked_prefixes` (Set of String) Prefixes currently linked to IRR routes.
- `not_valid_after` (String) Server-generated validity end.
- `not_valid_before` (String) Server-generated validity start.
- `recovery_data` (String, Sensitive) Provider recovery journal for an uncertain write. Empty after confirmation. Preserve this state until reconciliation succeeds.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import arin_roa.example EXAMPLE-1/ROA-HANDLE
```
